name: OracleTemplate.RingmasterAsgd.oracle_moments
type_text:
∀ {d : ℕ} {Ω : Type} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] (f : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d → ℝ)
  (g : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d → Ω → OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d) (μ : MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure Ω)
  (sigma : ℝ),
  LongTails.Setups.StochasticSmoothAndConvex.IsStochasticGradient (OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d) Ω (↑μ) f g sigma →
    ∀ (y : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d),
      MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun b => ‖g y b‖ ^ 2) ↑μ ∧ ∫ (b : Ω), ‖g y b‖ ^ 2 ∂↑μ ≤ sigma ^ 2 + ‖gradient f y‖ ^ 2
